fusions.name: Stride Sting
fusions.desc: Sends a bite at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt and move 10% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Journey's End
fusions.desc: A heavy blow that deals 28 damage, ignoring armour, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Its damage rises +5% per 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +50%).

fusions.name: Long Haul
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 18 seconds. You move 15% faster for 5s after using it.

fusions.name: Mile Eater
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you regain 2 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
